newsitem.title: USA: PLD Telekom reincorporates in U.S.
newsitem.headline: PLD Telekom reincorporates in U.S.

text.p: PLD Telekom Inc said Monday it has changed its corporate domicile from Canada to the United States.

PLD said its shareholders overwhelmingly approved the reincorporation at a special meeting held on February 27, and the move was subsequently effected by filings with the Ontario and Delaware regulatory authorities.

The company also said that it will be making announcements over the next few months regarding reorganization of its corporate structure and management, with the objective of simplifying the former and integrating the latter.

The first step in the management reorganization is the opening of a PLD representative office in St. Petersburg, Russia, and the appointment of Peter Owen Edmunds as the company's Representative Director, the company said. Owen Edmunds was most recently Deputy General Director at PeterStar, one of PLD's operating businesses, having served as PeterStar's Sales and Marketing Director since 1992.
